title: Covering sieve contains a covering presieve for a stable precoverage
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category, in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. A presieve on $X$ is a set of arrows with target $X$, and a sieve is a presieve closed under precomposition. Let $J$ be a precoverage on $\mathcal C$, that is, a collection $J(X)$ of presieves on every object. Suppose it contains singleton isomorphisms, is stable under composition of covering families, and its covering presieves admit pullbacks along every arrow, with the resulting pullback presieves in $J$. Let $J^{\mathrm{gen}}$ be the smallest Grothendieck topology containing the sieves generated by members of $J$ [def-weil-pbc-topos]. A sieve $R$ on $X$ belongs to $J^{\mathrm{gen}}(X)$ if and only if there is a presieve $P\in J(X)$ all of whose arrows belong to $R$.
